how_it_works: Wings generate lift from airflow; engines provide thrust; control surfaces and fly-by-wire or mechanical controls steer the aircraft in three axes.

# JAH Databases demo — record JAH-PH30-000017
# Embraer Phenom 300: Blueprint: cross-section
model = "Embraer Phenom 300"

print("specs: Length: 15.64 m; Wingspan: 15.91 m; Height: 5.09 m; Maximum takeoff weight: 8,150 kg; Engines: 2 × Pratt & Whitney Canada PW535E1; Typical seating: 6–10; Range: 3,724 km (Phenom 300E); Top speed: Mach 0.80")
print("OK: JAH-PH30-000017 verified")
